name: Stucco
summary: Remediation where it can be saved, full replacement where it can't. We'll tell you which at the consultation.
detail: Stucco remediation and fresh application. Where the substrate underneath has gone, patching it is money thrown away, and we'll tell you that at the consultation rather than after the invoice.
alt: A Thousand Oaks home mid-project, with damaged stucco stripped back before new siding goes on.
